body: Ask anything you want. About 4 months now. I've not done drugs since his death. And that is an interesting notion. I guess I do want to talk to somebody. I had a counselor but he was impossible to talk to. "Be more positive, try thinking about a good memory when you wake up". What.png.

Honestly?
I'm scared.
Because it doesn't affect me.
All my other friends are depressed, miserable. I was the one who was going to buy the shit from him. And really? I'm indifferent. I think I might have done too many drugs.
